items.title: Brazil’s Mercado Bitcoin halts withdrawals after $40 million drained across 10 chains
items.summary: The Brazilian exchange paused deposits and withdrawals after wallets on at least 10 chains were emptied, days after the $6.3 billion Binance hack.

items.title: No proof of AI in North Korean hackers move of stolen Binance funds
items.summary: Elliptic tracked thousands of transfers, failed swaps and repeated transactions that suggest the hackers relied on scripts rather than AI agents.

items.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.
